steps.en: Install all 23 skills globally for Codex with the skills CLI
steps.zh: 用 skills CLI 一次装齐 23 个技能（全局，Codex）

steps.en: Only for the card skill: install its Playwright Chromium renderer
steps.zh: 只有需要铸卡时，补装 Playwright Chromium
steps.code: cd ~/.agents/skills/ljg-card && bun install && bunx playwright install chromium

steps.en: Skills land in ~/.agents/skills/ and load when the task matches
steps.zh: 技能进入 ~/.agents/skills/，任务匹配时按需加载

steps.en: Hand it a paper, a book, or a knotty concept
steps.zh: 把一篇论文、一本书或一个绕口的概念交给它

steps.en: The skill runs its fixed method and delivers structured output, or a shareable long PNG card
steps.zh: 按固定方法交付结构化成果，或铸成可分享的长图卡

value.en: Reading, concept dissection and shareable cards done with one person's tested method, not bland summaries
value.zh: 读论文、拆概念、做卡片都有成型方法，不再得到平庸摘要

sources: README.md master @ fdea0be (retrieved 2026-09-28): 安装 `bunx skills add lijigang/ljg-skills -g -a codex --skill '*' -y`、`#md` 切 Markdown 分支; ljg-card 依赖 `cd ~/.agents/skills/ljg-card && bun install && bunx playwright install chromium`; 参数说明 `-g` 全局安装到 `~/.agents/skills/`; 技能表（ljg-paper、ljg-book、ljg-learn 八维度、ljg-card 四种 PNG）
